::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests panzoom's options** one at a time: opting out with
`.nopanzoom` and `#| panzoom: false`, and the per-cell `hint` and
`max-zoom` options. The page itself sets `loop: true`, so the gallery in
case 6 wraps around. There is no lightbox, so an image panzoom leaves alone
opens nothing. The `caption` and `description` options are on
[G: captions and descriptions](g-captions.html), `fit` on
[H: wide and tall figures](h-wide.html).

Each case says what to expect in its heading's attributes (`expect-open`,
`expect-hint`, `expect-max-zoom`), or on a
single image, and the browser test checks them.
:::

The cases below draw with this helper:

```{r}
wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  col <- hcl.colors(4, "Dark 3")[k]
  plot(x, sin(k * x), type = "n", main = paste("Wave", k), xlab = "x", ylab = "sin(kx)")
  polygon(c(x, rev(x)), c(sin(k * x), rep(0, length(x))), col = adjustcolor(col, 0.35), border = NA)
  lines(x, sin(k * x), lwd = 2, col = col)
}
```

## 1. `.nopanzoom` inside a `.panzoom` div {#c1}

The first image is marked `.nopanzoom`, so panzoom leaves it alone: with no
lightbox on this page, clicking it does nothing. The second opens the
viewer.

::: {.panzoom layout-ncol="2"}
![Opted out.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.nopanzoom expect-open="nothing"}

![Not opted out.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){expect-open="panzoom"}
:::

## 2. `#| panzoom: false` inside a `.panzoom` div {#c2 expect-open="nothing"}

The whole cell opts out.

::: {.panzoom}

```{r}
#| panzoom: false
#| fig-cap: "Opted out cell."

wave(k = 1)
```

:::

## 3. `hint: false` {#c3 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="hidden"}

The page shows the hint (the default); this cell hides it.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   hint: false

wave(k = 3)
```

## 4. Hint on by default {#c4 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="shown"}

```{r}
#| panzoom: true

wave(k = 4)
```

## 5. `max-zoom: 2` {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-max-zoom="2"}

Zooming in stops at 2 screen pixels per image pixel.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 2

wave(k = 1)
```

## 6. Gallery with `loop: true` {#c6 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three plots in one gallery. With the page's `loop: true`, `←` on the first
goes to the last, and "previous" is never disabled.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   group: waves
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "Wave one."
#|   - "Wave two."
#|   - "Wave three."

wave(k = 1)
wave(k = 2)
wave(k = 3)
```

## 7. Image with no alt text {#c7 expect-open="panzoom" expect-caption="none"}

With no alt text, panzoom's link around the image is labelled "Open image"
for screen readers (`npm run nojs` checks every link has a name).

![](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=40%}
